data.gist: Pain was assessed blinded by electronic von Frey paw withdrawal threshold and knee-bend scoring (max 20); joint swelling was measured as right-minus-left knee diameter by calipers at 4 and 8 weeks.
data.plain: Two pain tests were used: a calibrated probe measuring how much force on the hind paw triggers withdrawal, and a knee-bend test scoring vocalizations and resistance during passive flexion/extension. Swelling was quantified with calipers as the difference in knee width between operated and unoperated legs; testing was blinded and done in consistent order and time of day.
